parsed.note_claim: Kamome Shirahama values privacy and does not share photos of herself.
parsed.label: SUPPORTS
parsed.quote: For all of Shirahama's public appearances, she will be wearing a self-made mask to protect her privacy. Similarly, none of Shirahama's events will allow for recording of any type or photography.
